text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The dawn wind... and with it comes the
sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but gasp as I look up and
see light
pink clouds against a dazzling
morning sun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Temple bells ring out into the night as
the new
year arrives. On my way home
after a shrine
visit...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A plum-scented breeze blows down the

mountainside... It's already the season,
then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Trainer. Were you also
beckoned
here by an auspicious
updraft?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Well, I hope you have a
wonderful year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Right, I have to get going. Until next
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She says that, but curfew has already
long
passed, and it's dark outside. I can't
just let her
go off on her own.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Nowhere in particular. Just where the
wind takes
me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wherever it calls me, I will follow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow after her as she wanders about...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up at a spot with a clear view of
the first
sunrise of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's beautiful, isn't it? So this is where the

auspicious updraft was leading me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The first wind of spring blows past
iridescent
clouds, carrying the light as it
races north, south,
and west.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A new wind has been ushered in.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I hope many more wonderful days
await us this
year, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you
again,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Now, is that wind easterly or southerly?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A tailwind is blowing. Part of me wishes
to make
like the cyclone—barreling
downwards,
beckoning the winds as I go.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But it also feels like it'd be a waste to
turn my
back on this dawn breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps a clear day awaits us today.
A wind
we've yet to even anticipate
might blow.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Trainer? I can't quite
decide
where this wind is blowing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I get the impression she's asking me
about our
schedule after this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Beckoning the winds"... That must mean
training.
But should we enjoy this
scenery a little longer?
Or perhaps go
with a third option?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Beckon the winds, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Interesting. The first wind of spring
blows only
once. Indeed—we really can't
afford to miss this
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Further, faster! This is where I become
the spring
gale!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Whew... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I felt the wind more closely than usual
today—the
dancing wind of spring,
carrying petals on its
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps you'd let me run another lap?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Yamanin Zephyr runs more
lightly on her
feet than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, a new year begins.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Enjoy the view? ...Yes, we should. It
would be a
true shame to leave without
savoring the touch of
the year's first
easterly wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our minds made up, we decide to take
things
easy for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the sunlight like this, feeling
the wind
on my face, and listening to the
rustling of the
trees—I can't help but
feel a breath of fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, hehe. Look over there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look to where she's pointing.

text_block_list.name: Hawk
text_block_list.text: Kaw, kaaaw!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A large hawk is gliding effortlessly
across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's like the king of the azure winds of
the east. I
believe we've just caught a
glimpse of something
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I think this year is going to be a good
one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, a new year begins.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well then, let's go find this
unforeseen
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll live as leisurely as the spring winds,
and go
wherever my mood takes me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We start to make our way down the
mountain,
following a trail set by
Yamanin Zephyr's fancy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Why, look at the plum tree buds...
They're
already so full.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Such a pleasant fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It won't be long before the efflorescent
breeze
comes to let us know the plum
buds are in bloom,
and the cherry
blossoms soon after.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And then, April will arrive. ...I really have
to get
focused, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, a new year begins.
